findings.message: R1's Fix is incomplete, so the CRITICAL it reports would survive the revision: packages/client/src/test/features/zone_rules/steps/zone_rules_release.steps.ts:79 (scenario "A zone whose last type holds forever", feature step zone_rules_release.feature:18 'the zone rules of "Asia/Almaty" are read from the release "2026f"') also does `expect(committedRelease.release).toBe(release)`, pinning the committed release to 2026f. R1 lists only four tests (installZoneRules.test.ts:19, zoneRulesPlugin.virtualModules.test.ts:20, zone_rules_release.steps.ts:145, zoneAbbreviationsWorld.ts:69) and its new task would not touch line 79, so after the fix `pnpm test` in the publication workflow still fails on every new IANA release and FR1/G1 are still never delivered. The Fix must cover line 79 and its feature step as well.

R1's Fix limits the MODIFIED deltas to the zone-rules scenario 'The release carries its name' and the zone-abbreviations scenario. Other stable scenarios in openspec/specs/zone-rules/spec.md also name the committed release `2026f`: line 41 (Asia/Almaty 'read from the release `2026f`'), line 46 (Europe/Dublin 'read from the release `2026f`') and line 220 ('the zone rules check runs on the committed release `2026f`'). After archive they would contradict the first published release, so they need deltas too (or the Fix must explain why not).

R1's operator-notes caveat mentions only the zdump fixtures and zone-abbreviations.changes.json as content a new release can break. It omits the release-content assertions of zone_rules_release.steps.ts (Almaty's last listed change and future rule, Dublin's cutoff type and future rule), which also pin 2026f data and will fail when a release changes those zones, so the stated Fix risk understates what still blocks publication.

findings.message: R1's Fix (and its Fix risk) has task 8.4's operator notes name 'the zdump fixtures (src/test/zoneRules/fixtures/zdump/: America/New_York, Asia/Almaty, Europe/Dublin) used by `zone-rules:check`'. That contradicts the existing code: packages/client/scripts/zoneRules/check.ts reads the committed release (`JSON.parse(await dependencies.readFile(ZONE_RULES_RELEASE_FILE))`, line 49) and runs real `zdump` (`runProcess("zdump", ...)`, line 124). The fixtures are read only by the unit BDD scenario 'The committed release passes' (zone_rules_release.steps.ts:150-155, `compareWithRelease(committedRelease, zoneId, readZdump(zoneId))`). The Fix would put a wrong explanation of failed runs into zone-rules/README.md; it should attribute the fixture pin to that `pnpm test` scenario.

Missed WARNING-level contradiction: FR9 and the ADDED scenario 'Storage unavailable' (specs/zone-rules-updates/spec.md:146-150: 'storage is unavailable ... THEN the zone rules update notice is shown AND nothing is written') require the notice whose FR7 text promises 'Reload to use them.' But at start the app loads only the stored release or the bundled asset (design.md D3: `loadZoneRules` 'reads storedReleases.load() once ... fetches and reads the bundled asset ... installs the chosen release'; FR6). So when the write fails, Reload cannot apply the release: the promise is false, and every later check downloads it again and shows the notice again. The review has no finding resolving FR7/FR9 for this case (e.g. no notice when the save fails, or different text).
